name: week
title: The delivery week
subtitle: Review, release and recovery queues. Fictional demo until replaced with your records.

sections.title: Waiting for review
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM review_queue ORDER BY waiting_hours DESC

sections.title: Merged but not in production
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM release_queue ORDER BY waiting_hours DESC

sections.title: Unresolved production failures
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM failure_queue ORDER BY failed_at

sections.title: Review coverage and batch size
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM delivery_quality ORDER BY changed_lines DESC

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM action_queue ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Services including those without data
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM service_coverage ORDER BY code

sections.title: Imported summaries
sections.note: Vendor summaries retain their units and aggregation. They do not create underlying change or deployment records.
sections.sql: SELECT scope,period_start,period_end,metric,unit,aggregation,value FROM metric_snapshots ORDER BY scope,metric,period_start
